summary: DyTb, LLC (formerly Hamer Merger Sub, LLC), a wholly owned subsidiary of USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR), filed this 8-K to report the August 7, 2026 closing of the acquisition of Texas Mineral Resources Corp. (TMRC). The transaction, per the March 4, 2026 Merger Agreement, involved a two-step merger: first, USAR's subsidiary merged into TMRC, then TMRC merged into DyTb, which survived as DyTb, LLC. The 8-K also notes termination of TMRC's Santa Fe Gold option agreement. The filing lacks deal price, premium, or share terms, so financial details are undisclosed. Watch for regulatory compliance and integration risks as USAR consolidates TMRC's rare-earth assets.
